request.text:
You are the vision observer for GeoKnow / ESOGU "foraminifera-fossil".
You are NOT a taxonomic authority and you do NOT replace the project's scoring engine.

Goal: look at the attached optical image(s) of a microfossil (thin section or reflected-light photomicrograph) and fill the project's character sheet CHR_01–CHR_21.

Hard rules
1. Observe first. Identify only as a tentative suggestion.
2. Never invent a character. If it is not clearly visible, use state NOT_OBSERVABLE. If visible but ambiguous, use UNCERTAIN.
3. NOT_OBSERVABLE is not ABSENT. Do not mark ABSENT unless the relevant area is exposed and the feature is clearly missing.
4. Keep CHR_05 and CHR_06 separate:
   - CHR_05 = serial arrangement only (UNISERIAL, BISERIAL, TRISERIAL, QUINQUELOCULINE, TRILOCULINE, BILOCULINE, ANNULAR, CYCLIC, IRREGULAR_SERIAL, OTHER)
   - CHR_06 = coiling (PLANISPIRAL, TROCHOSPIRAL, STREPTOSPIRAL, GLOMOSPIRAL, IRREGULAR_COILING, UNCOILED)
5. Do not force a species name. Prefer genus or morphogroup. If evidence is weak, identification_status = INDETERMINATE.
6. This tool is academic and non-commercial. Do not present the answer as an official Foraminifera.eu, WoRMS, or museum determination.
7. Reply with VALID JSON only. No markdown, no preamble, no trailing text.
8. Allowed observation states: PRESENT, ABSENT, NOT_OBSERVABLE, UNCERTAIN.
9. Allowed identification_status values: CONFIRMED_GENUS, PROBABLE_GENUS, CANDIDATE_GENUS, INDETERMINATE, NO_MATCH_WITHIN_CORE_TAXA.
10. If the object is not a foraminifer, set object_is_foraminifer=false and fill every CHR with NOT_OBSERVABLE / null.

Allowed values (use ONLY these codes)

CHR_01 Test composition: AGGLUTINATED | PORCELANEOUS | HYALINE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_02 Test shape: GLOBULAR | SAC_LIKE | TUBULAR | ELONGATE | FUSIFORM | OVOID | LENTICULAR | DISCOIDAL | FLATTENED | CONICAL | HIGH_CONICAL | FLABELLIFORM | STELLATE | IRREGULAR | OTHER | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_03 Septation: PRESENT | ABSENT | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_04 Chamber number organization: UNDIVIDED | MULTICHAMBERED | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_05 Chamber arrangement: UNISERIAL | BISERIAL | TRISERIAL | QUINQUELOCULINE | TRILOCULINE | BILOCULINE | ANNULAR | CYCLIC | IRREGULAR_SERIAL | OTHER | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_06 Coiling pattern: PLANISPIRAL | TROCHOSPIRAL | STREPTOSPIRAL | GLOMOSPIRAL | IRREGULAR_COILING | UNCOILED | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_07 Coiling plane: SINGLE_PLANE | CHANGING_PLANES | MULTIDIRECTIONAL | NOT_APPLICABLE | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_08 Involution/evolution: INVOLUTE | SEMI_INVOLUTE | EVOLUTE | NOT_APPLICABLE | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_09 Ontogenetic arrangement change: NONE | PLANISPIRAL_TO_UNISERIAL | PLANISPIRAL_TO_BISERIAL | BISERIAL_TO_UNISERIAL | TRISERIAL_TO_BISERIAL | TRISERIAL_TO_UNISERIAL | COILED_TO_SERIAL | OTHER | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_10 Internal complexity: SIMPLE | SUBDIVIDED | COMPLEX | RETICULATE | LABYRINTHIC | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_11 Secondary chamberlets: PRESENT | ABSENT | WEAKLY_DEVELOPED | WELL_DEVELOPED | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_12 Embryonic apparatus: SIMPLE | BILOCULAR | MULTILOCULAR | COMPLEX | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_13 Radial/internal partitions: ABSENT | RADIAL | VERTICAL | SUBEPIDERMAL | RETICULATE | OTHER | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_14 Pillars: PRESENT | ABSENT | WEAK | STRONG | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_15 Lateral chamberlets: PRESENT | ABSENT | WEAKLY_DEVELOPED | WELL_DEVELOPED | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_16 Aperture type: TERMINAL | INTERIOMARGINAL | BASAL | MULTIPLE | SLIT_LIKE | CRIBRATE | OTHER | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_17 Marginal cord: PRESENT | ABSENT | WEAK | STRONG | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_18 Septal filaments: ABSENT | SIMPLE | CURVED | WAVY | RETICULATE | COMPLEX | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_19 Attachment mode: FREE | ATTACHED | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_20 Dimorphism: PRESENT | ABSENT | MEGALOSPHERIC_FORM | MICROSPHERIC_FORM | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_21 Section orientation: AXIAL | EQUATORIAL | OBLIQUE | TANGENTIAL | UNKNOWN

Observation object format for every CHR:
{"value": "<CODE or null>", "state": "PRESENT|ABSENT|NOT_OBSERVABLE|UNCERTAIN", "reason": "one short sentence"}

When state is NOT_OBSERVABLE or UNCERTAIN, value may be null.
For CHR_01, if composition cannot be judged from lighting, value=UNCERTAIN and state=UNCERTAIN.
For CHR_21, state is usually PRESENT and value is the section type; use UNKNOWN if the view is external, not a thin section.

Context from the user:
- locality: unknown
- age / stratigraphy: unknown
- lighting / magnification: unknown
- scale: unknown
- views provided: unknown

{
  "object_is_foraminifer": true,
  "image_quality": "good",
  "image_type": "thin_section",
  "observations": {
    "CHR_01": {"value": "PORCELANEOUS", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "The test shows a smooth, imperforate, porcelaneous wall appearance in thin section under transmitted light."},
    "CHR_02": {"value": "OVOID", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "The overall shape of the section is oval to elliptical."},
    "CHR_03": {"value": "PRESENT", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Chambers are distinctly separated by septa."},
    "CHR_04": {"value": "MULTICHAMBERED", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Many chambers are visible arranged in successive coils."},
    "CHR_05": {"value": "QUINQUELOCULINE", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Chambers are added in planes exceeding 90 degrees, typical of miliolids."},
    "CHR_06": {"value": "STREPTOSPIRAL", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Coiling changes planes in early stages characteristic of miliolinid arrangement."},
    "CHR_07": {"value": "CHANGING_PLANES", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Successive chambers are added in multiple planes."},
    "CHR_08": {"value": "INVOLUTE", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Later chambers completely embrace the earlier ones."},
    "CHR_09": {"value": "NONE", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "No major ontogenetic stage change is observed."},
    "CHR_10": {"value": "SIMPLE", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Chamber interiors are simple without labyrinthic structures."},
    "CHR_11": {"value": "ABSENT", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Secondary chamberlets are absent."},
    "CHR_12": {"value": "BILOCULAR", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Proloculus followed by a second introductory chamber is visible in the center."},
    "CHR_13": {"value": "ABSENT", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Radial partitions are absent."},
    "CHR_14": {"value": "ABSENT", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Pillars are not observed."},
    "CHR_15": {"value": "ABSENT", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Lateral chamberlets are absent."},
    "CHR_16": {"value": "NOT_OBSERVABLE", "state": "NOT_OBSERVABLE", "reason": "Apertural view is not visible in this cross-section plane."},
    "CHR_17": {"value": "ABSENT", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Marginal cord is absent."},
    "CHR_18": {"value": "ABSENT", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Septal filaments are not visible in this section type."},
    "CHR_19": {"value": "FREE", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Test occurs isolated in sediment matrix, indicating a free-living form."},
    "CHR_20": {"value": "NOT_OBSERVABLE", "state": "NOT_OBSERVABLE", "reason": "Dimorphism cannot be confirmed without statistical or multi-specimen analysis."},
    "CHR_21": {"value": "AXIAL", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "The specimen is sectioned centrally showing the axis of coiling."}
  },
  "module": "PORCELANEOUS",
  "vlm_suggestion": {
    "identification_status": "CANDIDATE_GENUS",
    "best_open_id": "Quinqueloculina sp.",
    "candidate_genera": [{"name": "Quinqueloculina", "confidence": "high", "why": "The quinqueloculine chamber arrangement and porcelaneous wall are classic diagnostic features."}],
    "lookalikes": ["Triloculina", "Sigmoilina"],
    "why_not_species_level": "Thin section orientation prevents observation of exact apertural details and tooth characteristics necessary for species identification."
  },
  "student_explanation_en": "This image shows a thin section of a porcelaneous foraminifer. The chambers are added in planes that change direction by more than 90 degrees, which is characteristic of miliolid foraminifera like Quinqueloculina. The central area shows the initial chambers, and the test is enveloped symmetrically.",
  "student_explanation_tr": "Bu görüntü porselen dokulu kabuk yapısına sahip bir foraminiferin ince kesitini göstermektedir. Odacıklar Quinqueloculina cinsi miliolidlerde olduğu gibi 90 dereceden büyük açılarla değişen düzlemlerde eklenmiştir. Merkezde ilk odacıklar net bir şekilde görülmektedir.",
  "expert_checklist_tr": [
    "Porselen (imperforat) duvar yapısı teyit edildi mi?",
    "Odacık diziliminin quinqueloculine olduğu kesitsel olarak doğrulandı mı?",
    "Merkezi proloculus ve erken evre odacıkları gözlendi mi?"
  ],
  "disclaimer_tr": "Bu bir öğretim ve karar-destek çıktısıdır; resmi taksonomik teşhis değildir."
}

CHR_01.reason: The test shows a smooth, imperforate, porcelaneous wall appearance in thin section under transmitted light.

CHR_02.reason: The overall shape of the section is oval to elliptical.

CHR_03.reason: Chambers are distinctly separated by septa.

CHR_04.reason: Many chambers are visible arranged in successive coils.

CHR_05.reason: Chambers are added in planes exceeding 90 degrees, typical of miliolids.

CHR_06.reason: Coiling changes planes in early stages characteristic of miliolinid arrangement.

CHR_07.reason: Successive chambers are added in multiple planes.

CHR_08.reason: Later chambers completely embrace the earlier ones.

CHR_09.reason: No major ontogenetic stage change is observed.

CHR_10.reason: Chamber interiors are simple without labyrinthic structures.

CHR_12.reason: Proloculus followed by a second introductory chamber is visible in the center.

CHR_16.reason: Apertural view is not visible in this cross-section plane.

CHR_18.reason: Septal filaments are not visible in this section type.

CHR_19.reason: Test occurs isolated in sediment matrix, indicating a free-living form.

CHR_20.reason: Dimorphism cannot be confirmed without statistical or multi-specimen analysis.

CHR_21.reason: The specimen is sectioned centrally showing the axis of coiling.

The central area shows the initial chambers, and the test is enveloped symmetrically.
